title: International Chronostratigraphic Chart: sourced reference transcription
adaptation_notice: PaleoGraph reference transcription of numeric interval properties, English labels and hierarchy. CamelCase source identifiers rendered readably only where an English preferred label is absent. Pridoli has both source ranks Age and Epoch and is presented once at Epoch rank. No intervals, ratification claims or colors invented; original inconsistent RDF values preserved alongside two explicitly documented official-PDF-supported boundary corrections. Includes all 178 chart units, so full Phanerozoic and ancestor context are available. Subepoch compositions require a separate cited registry. Two official-PDF-supported boundary corrections are applied to normalized numeric fields; original RDF values and precision strings remain in rdf_* fields and source_decimal. Correction evidence is recorded centrally and per affected unit.
citation: Cohen K, Harper D, Gibbard P, Car N. The ICS international chronostratigraphic chart this decade. Episodes2025;48:105-115. https://doi.org/10.18814/epiiugs/2025/025001
